Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable

# Case 019: Garden Maintenance Request

- **Today:** 2025-03-13 12:53:32 UTC (time of the latest event you can see)

## Initial request

Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable

You are the agency's operations agent at this point in the case. Read the history and attachments, work out where the case stands and what is still outstanding, then take the next action(s) the agency should take now with the tools available. Escalate only what genuinely needs a human decision.

State the next action(s) with recipient and channel, what they do not establish, and what remains open. Facts that arrive after the decision point are unknown to you.

content.thinking: The landlord's been silent for over a month and the records are conflicting - there's a note about approving the £500+VAT quote with Harbour Compliance but nothing in the landlord's own words, and the mention of "Oakley's contractor" raises ambiguity about whose contractor this actually is. Given the uncertainty, I'll send the landlord one clear question through a second channel like SMS, keep the tenant informed, and hold the case with a review date rather than escalating, since policy doesn't require escalation here.

arguments.decision_needed: Back garden at Flat 25, 185 Copperfield Walk: tenant asks for rubbish removal, levelling and gravel. Our notes show a £500 + VAT quote and a possible contractor of yours. Please reply yes or no: should we instruct our contractor (Harbour Compliance) at £500 + VAT, or will you arrange your own contractor (and if so, who and when)? We haven't been able to reach you by phone.
options: Yes, instruct our contractor up to £500 + VAT
I will arrange my own contractor (please give name and date)

arguments.body: Hello, thank you for chasing about the back garden. Sorry for the wait. We are still waiting for the landlord to confirm how they want the work done, and we haven't been able to reach them by phone. We have just sent them a clear yes/no question in writing. No work is booked yet. We will chase again and update you by 18 March. Thanks, Northbridge Lettings

arguments.note: Conflict: event 009 says landlord approved £500+VAT with Harbour Compliance; events 010-017 show no landlord reply ever, and mention Oakley's contractor. No landlord words recorded, so treated as not approved. Asked landlord yes/no on 2025-03-13.
